name: planscale-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 9 simple rung for the `planScale` flag (pro tier — the 'Scale plan…' row in the 2D floor-plan editor's 'Plan ▾' menu, PARITY-PLAN-SCALE). Enters the floor-plan editor in Simple mode and asserts the 'Scale plan…' row is ABSENT from the Plan menu, switches to Pro + reresolves flags and asserts the row now appears, opens the ScalePlanModal. REAL BUG FOUND + documented here (not worked around in source, only in the test): the modal's default factor value '2' FAILS the number input's own native HTML5 step validation (min={0.01} step={0.1} in ScalePlanModal.tsx — the browser reports 'the two nearest valid values are 1.91 and 2.01', so clicking 'Scale' with the untouched default silently no-ops in every browser that enforces native constraint validation). The ladder asserts this stepMismatch reproduces, then types a step-aligned '2.01' to actually exercise the apply path, asserting the plan's wall-bounding-box area scales by ~factor^2, then undoes the rescale and confirms the plan reverts to its original footprint.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: planScale should be OFF in Simple mode (it is pro-tier)

steps.name: open-plan-menu-simple
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan ▾ menu button not found/did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-scale-row-absent-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Scale plan')) throw new Error('Scale plan row visible in Simple mode Plan menu (should be Pro-only, planScale is pro-tier)'); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: planScale should be ON once switched to Pro mode

steps.name: capture-bbox-before
steps.eval: (function(){ function bbox(walls){ let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity; for (const w of walls){ for (const p of [w.start, w.end]){ if (p[0]<minX) minX=p[0]; if (p[0]>maxX) maxX=p[0]; if (p[1]<minY) minY=p[1]; if (p[1]>maxY) maxY=p[1]; } } return (maxX-minX)*(maxY-minY); } const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; window.__areaBefore = bbox(plan.walls); if (!(window.__areaBefore > 0)) throw new Error('Expected a positive baseline wall bounding-box area'); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-pro
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan ▾ menu button not found/did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-scale-row-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Scale plan')) throw new Error('Scale plan row missing in Pro mode Plan menu'); })()

steps.name: click-scale-plan-row
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Scale plan…'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Scale plan…' button not found in Plan menu"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-scale-modal-title
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.modal-overlay .panel')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Scale plan')) throw new Error('Scale-plan modal did not render its title/content'); })()

steps.name: assert-default-factor-2
steps.eval: (function(){ const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Scale factor"]'); if (!input) throw new Error('Scale-factor input not found'); if (input.value !== '2') throw new Error('Expected default factor 2, got ' + input.value); })()

steps.name: confirm-real-bug-default-factor-fails-native-validation
steps.eval: (function(){ const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Scale factor"]'); if (!input) throw new Error('Scale-factor input not found'); if (!input.validity.stepMismatch) throw new Error('REGRESSION CHECK: expected the KNOWN BUG (default factor "2" failing native stepMismatch against min=0.01/step=0.1) to still repro — if this throws, the modal was fixed and this workaround/report is stale'); })()

steps.name: set-step-aligned-factor
steps.eval: (function(){ const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Scale factor"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, '2.01'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); if (input.validity.stepMismatch) throw new Error('2.01 should be step-aligned (min 0.01 + n*0.1) and pass native validation'); })()

steps.name: submit-scale
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay .panel button')].find((b) => b.type === 'submit' && b.textContent.trim() === 'Scale'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Scale' submit button not found"); if (btn.disabled) throw new Error('Scale submit button is disabled'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-area-quadrupled
steps.eval: (function(){ function bbox(walls){ let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity; for (const w of walls){ for (const p of [w.start, w.end]){ if (p[0]<minX) minX=p[0]; if (p[0]>maxX) maxX=p[0]; if (p[1]<minY) minY=p[1]; if (p[1]>maxY) maxY=p[1]; } } return (maxX-minX)*(maxY-minY); } const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const after = bbox(plan.walls); const ratio = after / window.__areaBefore; if (ratio < 3.5 || ratio > 4.5) throw new Error('Expected wall bounding-box area to roughly quadruple (x2 factor squared), got ratio ' + ratio); window.__areaAfter = after; })()

steps.name: assert-area-reverted
steps.eval: (function(){ function bbox(walls){ let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity; for (const w of walls){ for (const p of [w.start, w.end]){ if (p[0]<minX) minX=p[0]; if (p[0]>maxX) maxX=p[0]; if (p[1]<minY) minY=p[1]; if (p[1]>maxY) maxY=p[1]; } } return (maxX-minX)*(maxY-minY); } const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const reverted = bbox(plan.walls); const ratio = reverted / window.__areaBefore; if (ratio < 0.9 || ratio > 1.1) throw new Error('Expected the undo to revert the plan back to its original bounding-box area, got ratio ' + ratio); })()
